config.cyd.status_no_devices: No display has checked in yet. Flash aurago-cyd and paste a cyd token.
config.cyd.token_copy_hint: Paste it into the CYD captive portal. It cannot be shown again.
config.cyd.setup_help: Flash https://github.com/antibyte/aurago-cyd, join the agocyd-XXXX portal, and enter this AuraGo LAN URL plus the token below. AuraGo must listen on a LAN address, not only 127.0.0.1.
config.cyd.flash_hint: Use PlatformIO env cyd or cyd2usb. Hold BOOT 5s on the display to reopen the portal.
help.cyd.enabled: Enables the Cheap Yellow Display mini-dashboard. The agent can show overlays with send_notification channel cyd or cyd_display.
help.cyd.poll_seconds: How often the display fetches /api/cyd/snapshot if WebSocket is down. Minimum 2 seconds.
help.cyd.overlay_ttl: Default seconds a notification stays on the glass unless dismissed.
help.cyd.allow_agent_control: When enabled, the agent may change page, brightness, and LED. Overlays still work if this is off.
help.cyd.mqtt_mirror: Also publish the compact snapshot to MQTT topic aurago/cyd/snapshot when MQTT is connected.
